property_summary: If transfer returns (i.e., does not revert) then it returns true and c.from and c.caddress are unchanged and transfer accepted only when called by c.from and with non-empty _tos.
If c.transfer does not revert when called from this test, then it must return true and c.from and c.caddress remain unchanged.
Whenever transfer is called with matching non-empty arrays and does not revert, it returns true.
When transfer is invoked with non-empty equal-length arrays by the required sender, it either reverts or returns true (i.e., it never returns false).
For any non-empty equal-length inputs sent by the required sender, c.transfer either reverts or returns true (it never returns false).
Calling transfer with non-empty _tos by the authorized from address never changes c.from or c.caddress and always returns true when it does not revert.
